label: Brave Search
agentGuide: GET /web/search?q=<words>&count=10&country=fr&search_lang=fr (also &freshness=pw for the past week, &safesearch=moderate). Results in web.results[] with title, url, description, age; news in news.results[]. News only: GET /news/search?q=...; images: GET /images/search?q=...; suggestions: GET /suggest/search?q=... Each call costs a query on the plan: ask once with a good query rather than many narrow ones, and cite the url of what you use.
